features.title: Map View
features.description: The map is the town's main stage. Watch residents move, weather shift, buildings fill up, and interactions happen on actual tiles.
bullets: Scroll to zoom, drag to pan, and double-click a resident to follow them.
Right-click the map for context actions tied to tiles, residents, and event entry points.
The top HUD continuously shows time, weather, and season.

features.title: Relationship Graph
features.description: The graph on the right visualizes love, friendship, rivalry, and acquaintance links so you can track how social structure evolves over time.
bullets: Hover an edge to inspect relationship type and intensity.
Timeline replay lets you restore the graph to historical ticks.
Graph and map selection work together to show who is influencing whom.

features.title: God Mode Tools
features.description: Director controls, persona editing, and resident creation are your intervention panels. Use them to rewrite fate and manufacture drama on demand.
bullets: Director tools are best for injecting emotions, arranging encounters, and spreading rumors.
Persona editing changes traits, goals, and current mood.
The resident wizard can drop a new character straight into the current social web.

features.title: Events and Saves
features.description: Event injection adds pressure to the town, while saves freeze the current world state. Together they support reproducible experiments and branching narratives.
bullets: Preset events quickly trigger storms, strangers, and other dramatic setups.
Custom events are useful for testing prompts, relationship evolution, and crowd reactions.
Save, branch, and reload to compare how the town diverges under different decisions.

items.question: Why am I stuck on the loading screen?
items.answer: Usually the backend or WebSocket is not up yet. Confirm `docker compose up` is running, then retry the connection.

items.question: What is the difference between the daily report and the experiment report?
items.answer: The daily report is a lightweight dramatic summary for sharing, while the experiment report aggregates multi-day relationship changes, metrics, and longer-form analysis.

items.question: I injected an event but nothing changed immediately. What now?
items.answer: Check whether the simulation is paused, then watch the feed, timeline, and graph. Some effects only become visible after residents complete another tick.

items.question: Can I use saves to replay different narrative branches?
items.answer: Yes. Save a baseline state, inject different events or parameters, then reload the baseline to run controlled comparisons.
